query: This repo has ballooned over two years and I suspect a lot of it is never executed. Can you go through the whole thing and tell me what's safe to delete, most valuable first?
We inherited this service and it feels three times bigger than the problem it solves. Give me a prioritised list of the fat to trim — don't change anything yet.
I keep finding little helper modules that just reimplement things the standard library already does. Sweep the codebase and tell me everywhere we've rebuilt the wheel.
There are half a dozen base classes and protocols in here that only ever have one concrete subclass. Can you find all of those and rank how much noise each one is costing us?
Do a YAGNI pass over this project — I want to know how much of this we built for a future that never showed up.
We have feature flags from a migration that finished last year and I bet they're all permanently on now. What config and flags can we rip out?
Before I onboard two new devs I want an honest read on how much of this code surface is actually load-bearing. Report only, no edits.
Half these classes look like they just forward every call straight to another object. Can you check the whole repo for that pattern and tell me which ones to collapse?
I'm running an architecture review workflow and one of the steps needs a bloat audit of the repo to feed into the candidate list.
Collect all the SHORTCUT markers we left in the code during TDD and group them by file so I can see which ones never got an upgrade path.
Scan for deepening and simplification opportunities and give me the dual-axis HTML report, then grill me on whichever candidate I pick.
Go ahead and delete the dead code you find and collapse those wrappers — just make the changes and run the tests.
Extract the duplicated validation out of these three handlers into one function without changing behaviour.
Review my current diff for correctness bugs and edge cases I might have missed.
Something in the checkout flow started throwing 500s after yesterday's deploy and I have no idea which change caused it.
Our test suite takes 40 minutes. Which of these tests belong in which tier and what should we stop running on every push?
This module has no tests and unclear behaviour — help me get characterization tests around it before I touch it.
Audit our dependencies for known CVEs and outdated versions.
